headline: Citrix patches NetScaler zero-day exploited in attacks
summary: Citrix released emergency patches for CVE-2026-88779, a NetScaler flaw causing denial of service that attackers have already exploited as a zero-day, amid continuing reports of further 0-days in NetScaler products.

claims.statement: CVE-2026-88779 is a NetScaler memory overflow bug that causes denial of service and has already been exploited as a zero-day.

sources.quote: Citrix patches NetScaler SAML zero-day exploited in attacks
The new vuln, CVE-2026-88779, is a memory overflow bug that leads to denial of service

claims.statement: Citrix released emergency updates for the vulnerability, even as more Citrix NetScaler zero-day reports surface.

sources.quote: Citrix has released emergency updates for a new NetScaler denial-of-service vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-88779
Citrix NetScaler security snafus get even worse amid more 0-day reports
